svg.title: Extreme set: jet drones and fast aircraft
svg.desc: Five panels overlay the jet drone and fast aircraft versions of each maneuver: climb, dive, 3D weave, 90 degree turn, and brake, turn and reverse. In four panels the aircraft shape is larger because its g limit is lower. The weave panel shows two different random paths. A sixth cell holds notes.
svg.text: Extreme set: jet drones and fast aircraft
Five maneuvers for each class, drawn together. Test limits in the generator, not measured vehicle performance:
start and end of the part drawn
equal time steps: wide is fast
Each panel is a short part of a 300 s track, at its own scale. g is acceleration in units of 9.81 m/s².
Outside the part drawn, the target flies straight and level at constant speed, or hovers.
Climb at 45°, hold 1 s, level out
From the side. Dots every 5 s.
Dive at 45°, hold 1 s, level out
From the side. Dots every 5 s.
Different random paths. Dots every 10 s.
From above, north up. Dots every 5 s.
Brake to 20% speed, turn 180°, speed up
From above, north up. Dots every 5 s.
The top speeds are almost equal, so the
lower g limit makes a maneuver take longer
and cover more ground. weave-3d is the
exception: its two tracks are different
random paths, so their shapes cannot
The aircraft is drawn wider so that both
tracks show. In each track, the thicker
Paths and speed strips are aligned where
The limits include the 1 g that holds the
vehicle up, so climb, dive and weave-3d
